Kira (Design): Heads-up 1 proposed micro-preview inside the alert editor: shows effective threshold, channels, and any active suppression. Mock: https://figma.redwood/mini-preview. Quick feedback on copy + SR announcements?

Noah (Eng): Nice. Concern: preview triggers extra API calls on every change. Recommend debounce and include preview in initial form payload.

Lina (A11y): For screen readers, make the preview a `region` with `aria-live=polite`. Also add a skip-link so keyboard users can jump past repeat info. Example: "Alert preview: will notify Slack and PagerDuty; suppression active until Apr 12."

Owen (Product): Copy nit: prefer "Suppression window" (UI) and note "also called quiet window" in helptext. Preview sentence should start "Will notify" not "Notifies".

Jules (PM): Mobile: collapse channels into "1 primary +2" pill, ensure collapsed pill has `aria-label` listing all channels. Add small badge for fallbacks with tooltip "reasons: routing / capacity".

Kira (Design): Great. I'll update the mock with aria snippets, debounce guidance, and collapsed-state aria-label. Target: update Figma today and ping for quick review.

Noah (Eng): I'll implement debounce + initial payload change.

Lina (A11y): Happy to review ARIA copy after update.

Kira (Design): Thanks all!
